description: Holacracy plugin SessionStart hook. Injects a role-grounding directive that demands the session resolve + announce its active Holacratic role/circle before its first action, honest by construction (it requests the load, never claims it happened) -- emitted ONLY when an authenticated GlassFrog connector is detected, since without one the directive cannot be carried out; otherwise one informational line says it was withheld. Nothing this hook emits ever poses a question. Also surfaces today's scheduled-task routines (tagged holacracy/*) and any anomalies. Emits a quiet marker rather than nothing when there is nothing to report. Fail-silent on error so a broken hook never blocks a session.
